newsitem.title: ESTONIA: ESTONIA-TALLINN WATER BOOSTS CP PROGRAMME.
newsitem.headline: ESTONIA-TALLINN WATER BOOSTS CP PROGRAMME.

text.p: Tallinn Water and Sewage company on Monday issued new three-month commercial papers worth 50 million kroons at a yield of 7.48 percent, lower than its previous issue, Hansapank said.

Erkki Raasuke, head of Hansapank interest rate products and financial risk department, told Reuters that the company issued its first CPs at a yield of 1.25 percent over Talibor whereas the new issue was at the same level as Talibor.
The reason for the lower yield of this issue was due to the lower Talibor rate and a letter of support by Tallinn city government to the company, Raasuke said.
Raasuke said the issue was not a redemption of any previous issue as the company has increased its programme size from 100 million kroons to 150 million kroons.
